topicName: Monitoring, Logging, Audit Trails, and Metrics (Prometheus)
content:
[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Monitoring, Logging, Audit Trails, and Metrics (Prometheus) in Jenkins"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Enterprise CI/CD pipelines require robust observability. This tutorial covers how to configure monitoring, logging, audit trails, and Prometheus metrics integration in Jenkins."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"1. Metrics Collection with Prometheus"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"Jenkins does not expose Prometheus metrics out of the box. You need to install the Prometheus Metrics Plugin to scrape Jenkins performance metrics, JVM statistics, and job execution times."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Navigate to Manage Jenkins -> Plugins -> Available plugins."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Search for and install the "Prometheus metrics plugin"."},{"order":7,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Restart Jenkins if prompted."},{"order":8,"type":"paragraph","text":"Once installed, Jenkins exposes an endpoint at /prometheus/ that your Prometheus server can scrape."},{"order":9,"type":"code","text":"scrape_configs:
  - job_name: 'jenkins'
    metrics_path: '/prometheus/'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['your-jenkins-server:8080']"},{"order":10,"type":"subheading","text":"2. Configuring Jenkins Logging"},{"order":11,"type":"paragraph","text":"Jenkins uses java.util.logging. You can configure custom log recorders to capture specific subsystem events without flooding your primary log file."},{"order":12,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Go to Manage Jenkins -> System Log."},{"order":13,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Click Add new log recorder."},{"order":14,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Add loggers such ashudson.model.Run for build executions or jenkins.security for authentication logs."},{"order":15,"type":"subheading","text":"3. Audit Trails for Compliance"},{"order":16,"type":"paragraph","text":"Audit trails record who made changes to Jenkins configurations, jobs, or security settings. The Audit Trail Plugin provides this functionality."},{"order":17,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Install the Audit Trail Plugin from the Plugin Manager."},{"order":18,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Navigate to Manage Jenkins -> Configure System."},{"order":19,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Find the Audit Trail section and enable logging for HTTP requests, administrative actions, and workspace modifications."},{"order":20,"type":"code","text":"Augmented audit log output example:
[2023-10-25T10:15:30.123Z] User 'admin' executed script on job 'production-deploy'"},{"order":21,"type":"subheading","text":"Summary"},{"order":22,"type":"paragraph","text":"By combining Prometheus for metrics, structured log recorders for debugging, and the Audit Trail plugin for compliance, your Jenkins infrastructure becomes fully observable and secure."}]
